retrievalProfile.description: A centered musician portrait in a cluttered backstage dressing room featuring a large, bold, outlined header and a secondary script sub-title.
triggerTerms: musician sitting on chair with guitar

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a subject seated backwards on a chair in a dressing room, framed by a large mirror and vanity. The composition is anchored by a heavy, blocky title at the top that spans the width of the frame, utilizing a high-contrast outline and a secondary cursive element overlapping the main text.
coreVisualRelationships: Title spanning the top horizontal margin
Mirror reflection providing depth behind the subject
Diagonal guitar placement balancing the lower right quadrant
coreInvariants: Dressing room setting with vanity and mirrors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, seated, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blue, outlined title at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold header, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the legs and guitar to the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the scene is dense with props like guitars, flowers, and vanity items.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and neutral tones (vanity, walls, subject's clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary blues and reds against a desaturated, brightly lit background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters to create a continuous block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif paired with a fluid, slanted script for dynamic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the primary title.
Approximates the informal, slanted secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a male musician with 70s-style hair sitting backwards on a black chair in a cluttered backstage dressing room. Include a blue carpet, a vanity with mirrors, and an electric guitar leaning against a wall. Ensure bright, even indoor lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, uppercase, bold blue sans-serif title across the top with a thick white outline. Overlay a smaller red script subtitle at a slight angle, partially covering the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the main title uppercase and bold?
Does the title have a visible outline?
Is there a secondary script font overlapping the main text?
Is the subject centered in a dressing room environment?

adjustableVariables: Color of the title fill and outline
Specific props in the dressing room (e.g., flowers, drinks)
Angle of the secondary script text
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure the text content is original

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy between title and subject
Sharp, legible typography despite the outline

postGenerationChecks: Check that the title spans at least 80% of the width.
Verify the blue of the carpet matches the blue of the text.
Ensure the mirror reflection shows a plausible continuation of the room.
Confirm the guitar is a distinct visual element in the foreground.
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated portrait + cluttered backstage setting + bold outlined header + overlapping script subtitle.
